sections.label: The hyperbolical glorification of the Vratya or Aryan Non-conformist
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 1

verses.sa: व्रात्य आसीदीयमान एव स प्रजापतिं समैरयत्॥
verses.tr: vrātya āsīdīyamāna eva sa prajāpatiṃ samairayat
verses.en: There was a roaming Vratya. He roused Prajapati to action,

verses.sa: स प्रजापतिः सुवर्णमात्मन्नपश्यत् तत् प्राजनयत्॥
verses.tr: sa prajāpatiḥ suvarṇamātmannapaśyat tat prājanayat
verses.en: Prajapati beheld gold in himself and engendered it,

verses.sa:
त देकमभवत् तल्ललाममभवत् तन्महदभवत् तज्ज्येष्ठमभवत् तद्
ब्रह्माभवत् तत् तपोऽभवत् तत् सत्यमभवत् तेन प्राजायत॥
verses.tr: ta dekamabhavat tallalāmamabhavat tanmahadabhavat tajjyeṣṭhamabhavat tad brahmābhavat tat tapo'bhavat tat satyamabhavat tena prājāyata
verses.en: That became unique, that became distinguished, that became great, that became excellent, that became Devotion, that became holy Fervour, that became Truth: through that he was born.

verses.sa: सोऽवर्धत स महानभवत् स महादेवोऽभवत्॥
verses.tr: so'vardhata sa mahānabhavat sa mahādevo'bhavat
verses.en: He grew, he became great, he became Mahadeva,

verses.sa: स देवानामीशां पर्यैत् स ईशानोऽभवत्॥
verses.tr: sa devānāmīśāṃ paryait sa īśāno'bhavat
verses.en: He gained the lordship of the Gods, He became Lord,

verses.sa: स एकव्रात्योऽभवत् स धनुरादत्त तदेवेन्द्र धनुः॥
verses.tr: sa ekavrātyo'bhavat sa dhanurādatta tadevendra dhanuḥ
verses.en: He became Chief Vratya. He held a bow, even that Bow of Indra,

verses.sa: नीलमस्योदरं लोहितं पृष्ठम्॥
verses.tr: nīlamasyodaraṃ lohitaṃ pṛṣṭham
verses.en: His belly is dark-blue, his back is red,

verses.sa: नीलेनैवाप्रियं भ्रातृव्यं प्रोर्णोति लोहितेन द्विषन्तं विध्यतीति ब्रह्मवादिनो वदन्ति॥
verses.tr: nīlenaivāpriyaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ prorṇoti lohitena dviṣantaṃ vidhyatīti brahmavādino vadanti
verses.en: With dark-blue he envelops a detested rival, with red he pierces the man who hates him: so the theologians say.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 2

verses.en: He arose and went his way to the eastern region, The Brihat, the Rathantara, the Adityas and all the Gods followed him. That man is alienated from. the Brihat, the Rathantara, the Adityas, and all Gods who reviles the Vratya who possesses this knowledge. He who hath this knowledge becomes the beloved home of the Brihat, the Rathantara, the Adityas, and all the Gods, In the eastern region Faith is his leman, the hymn his panegyrist, knowledge his vesture, day his turban, night his hair, Indra's two Bays his circular ornaments, the splendour of the stars his jewel, Present and Future are his running footmen, mind is his war-chariot, Matarisvan and Pavamana are they who draw it, Vata is his charioteer, Storm his goad, Fame and Glory are his harbingers. Fame and Glory come to him who hath this knowledge.

He arose and went away to the southern region, Yajuayajuiya and Vamadevya and Sacrifice and Sacrificer and sacrificial victims followed him. The man who reviles the Vratya possessing this knowledge is alienated from Yajnayajniya and Vamadevya, Sacrifice, Sacrificer and sacrificial victims. He who hath this knowledge becomes the beloved home of Yajnayajniya, Vamadevya, Sacrifice, Sacrificer, and sacrificial victims, In the southern region Dawn is his leman, Mitra his panegyrist, knowledge his vesture, day his turban, night his hair, Indra's two Bays are his circular ornaments, New Moon Night and Full Moon Night are his running attendants, Mind, etc. as in stanza I.

He arose and went away to the western region. Vairupa and Vairaja, the Waters, and King Varuna followed him. He who reviles the Vratya possessing this knowledge is alienated from Varana and Vairaja, the Waters and Varuna the King, He who possesses this knowledge becomes the dear home of Vairupa and Vairaja, the Waters and King Varuna. In the western region Ira is his leman, Laughter his panegyrist, knowledge, etc, as above, Day and Night are his running attendants, Mind, etc. as above.

He arose and went away to the northern: region. Syaita and Naudhasa, the Seven Rishis, and King Soma followed him. He who reviles the Vratya possessing this knowledge is alienated from Syaita, etc. He who hath this knowledge becomes the dear home of Syaita, etc, In the northern region Lightning is his leman, Thunder his panegyrist, etc. as above. Revelation and "Tradition are his running attendants, Mind, etc, as above.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 3

verses.sa:
स संवत्सरमूर्ध्वोऽतिष्ठत् तं देवा अब्रुवन् व्रात्य किं नु तिष्ठसीति॥
सोऽब्रवीदासन्दीं मे सं भरन्त्विति॥
verses.tr: sa saṃvatsaramūrdhvo'tiṣṭhat taṃ devā abruvan vrātya kiṃ nu tiṣṭhasīti so'bravīdāsandīṃ me saṃ bharantviti
verses.en: For a whole year he stood erect. The Gods said unto him, Why standest thou, O Vratya? He answered and said, Let them bring my couch,

verses.sa: तस्मै व्रात्यायासन्दीं समभरन्॥
verses.tr: tasmai vrātyāyāsandīṃ samabharan
verses.en: They brought the couch for that Vratya.

verses.sa: तस्या ग्रीष्मश्च वसन्तश्च द्वौ पादावास्तां शरच्च वर्षाश्च द्वौ॥
verses.tr: tasyā grīṣmaśca vasantaśca dvau pādāvāstāṃ śaracca varṣāśca dvau
verses.en: Two of its feet were Summer and Spring, and two were Autumn and the Rains,

verses.sa: बृहच्च रथंतरं चानूच्ये३ आस्तां यज्ञायज्ञियं च वामदेव्यं च तिरश्च्ये॥
verses.tr: bṛhacca rathaṃtaraṃ cānūcye3 āstāṃ yajñāyajñiyaṃ ca vāmadevyaṃ ca tiraścye
verses.en: Brihat and Rathantara were the two long boards, Yajiiayajfiiya and Vamadevya the two cross-boards.

verses.sa: ऋचः प्राञ्चस्तन्तवो यजूंषि तिर्यञ्चः॥
verses.tr: ṛcaḥ prāñcastantavo yajūṃṣi tiryañcaḥ
verses.en: Holy verses were the strings lengthwise, and Yajus formulas the cross-tapes.

verses.sa: वेद आस्तरणं ब्रह्मोपबर्हणम्॥
verses.tr: veda āstaraṇaṃ brahmopabarhaṇam
verses.en: Sacred lore was the blanket, Devotion the coverlet,

verses.sa: सामासाद उद्गीथोऽपश्रयः॥
verses.tr: sāmāsāda udgītho'paśrayaḥ
verses.en: The Saman was the cushion, and chanting the bolster.

verses.sa: तामासन्दीं व्रात्य आरोहत्॥
verses.tr: tāmāsandīṃ vrātya ārohat
verses.en: The Vratya ascended that couch.

verses.sa: तस्य देवजनाः परिष्कन्दा आसन्त्संकल्पाः प्रहाय्या३ विश्वानि भूतान्युपसदः॥
verses.tr: tasya devajanāḥ pariṣkandā āsantsaṃkalpāḥ prahāyyā3 viśvāni bhūtānyupasadaḥ
verses.en: The hosts of Gods were his attendants, solemn vows his messengers, and all creatures his worshippers,

verses.sa: विश्वान्येवास्य भूतान्युपसदो भवन्ति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: viśvānyevāsya bhūtānyupasado bhavanti ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: All creatures become the worshippers of him who possesses this knowledge,

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 4

verses.en: For him they made the two Spring months protectors from the eastern region, and Brihat and Rathantara superintendents. The two Spring months protect from the eastern region, and Brihat and Rathantara superintend, the man who possesses this knowledge. For him they made. the two Summer months protectors from the southern region, and Yajfayajuiya and Vamadevya superintendents. The two Summer months, etc. as in Verse I, mutatis mutatis,
They made the two Rain months, his protectors from the western region, and Vairupa and Vairaja superintendents, The two Rain months, etc. as above.
They made the two Autumn months his protectors from the northern region, and Syaita and Naudhasa superintendents. The two Autumn months, etc. as above.
They made the two Winter months his protectors from the region of the nadir, and earth and Agni superintendents, The two Winter months, etc.
They made the two Dewy months his protectors from the region of the zenith, and Heaven and the Adityas superintendents. The two Dewy months, etc.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 5

verses.en: For him they made the Archer Bhava a deliverer from the intermediate space of the eastern region. Bhava the Archer, a deliverer, delivers him from the intermediate space ofthe eastern region, Neither Sarva nor Bhava nor Isana slays him who Bright), or Jyeshtha and Ashadha; mid-May to mid-July.
Rain months: Sravana and Bhadra; mid-July to mid-September.
Autumn. months: Asvina and Karttika; mid-September to mid-November.
Winter months: Agrahayana and Pausha; mid-November to mid-January.

Dewy months: Magha and Phalguna; mid-January to possesses this knowledge, or his cattle, or his kinsmen. They made Sarva the Archer his deliverer from the intermediate space of the southern region, etc, as in verse I, mutatis mutatis, They made Pasupati the Archer his deliverer from the intermediate space of the western region, etc. They made the Awful God, the Archer, his deliverer from the intermediate space of the northern region, etc, as above. They made Rudra the Archer his deliverer from the intermediate space of the region of the nadir, etc, They made Mahadeva his deliverer from the intermediate space of the region of the zenith, etc.

They made Isana the Archer his deliverer from all the intermediate regions, isana the Archer, a deliverer, delivers him from all the intermediate regions. Neither Sarva, nor Bhava, nor Isana slays him who possesses this knowledge, or his cattle, or his kinsmen.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 6

verses.en: He went his way to the region of the nadir. Earth and Agni and herbs and trees and shrubs and plants followed him. He who possesses this knowledge becomes the dear home of Earth and Agni and herbs and trees and shrubs and plants.
He went his way to the region of the zenith. Right and Truth and Sun and Moon and Stars followed him. He who possesses this knowledge becomes, etc, as in verse I, mutatis mutatis,
He went away to the last region. Richas, Samans Yajus formulas and Devotion followed him. He who, etc, as above,
He went away to the great region, Itihasa and Purana and Gathas and Narasansis followed him. He who, etc.
Ha went away to the supreme region. The Ahavaniya, Garhapatya, and Southern Fires, and Sacrifice, and. Sacrificer, and sacrificial victims followed him, He who, etc.
He went away to the unindicated region, The Seasons, groups of seasons, the worlds and their inhabitants, the months and half-months, and Day and Night followed him. He who, etc.
He went away to the unfrequented region. Thence he thought that he should not return, Diti and Aditi and Ida and Indrani followed him. He who, etc.
He went away to the regions. Viraj and all the Gods and all the Deities followed him. He who, etc.

He went away to all the intermediate spaces. Prajapati and Parameshthin and the Father and the Great Father followed him, He who possesses this knowledge becomes the beloved home of Prajapati and Parameshthin and the Father and the Great Father,

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 7

verses.sa: स महिमा सद्रुर्भूत्वान्तं पृथिव्या अगच्छत् स समुद्रोऽभवत्॥
verses.tr: sa mahimā sadrurbhūtvāntaṃ pṛthivyā agacchat sa samudro'bhavat
verses.en: He, having become moving majesty, went to the ends of the earth. He became the sea.

verses.sa: तं प्रजापतिश्च परमेष्ठी च पिता च पितामहश्चापश्च श्रद्धा च वर्षं भूत्वानुव्यऽवर्तयन्त॥
verses.tr: taṃ prajāpatiśca parameṣṭhī ca pitā ca pitāmahaścāpaśca śraddhā ca varṣaṃ bhūtvānuvya'vartayanta
verses.en: Prajapati and Parameshthin and the Father and the Great Father and the Waters and Faith, turned into rain, followed him.

verses.sa: ऐनमापो गच्छत्यैनं श्रद्धा गच्छत्यैनं वर्षं गच्छति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: ainamāpo gacchatyainaṃ śraddhā gacchatyainaṃ varṣaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: The Waters, Faith, and rain approach him who possesses this knowledge.

verses.sa: तं श्रद्धा च यज्ञश्च लोकश्चान्नं चान्नाद्यं च भूत्वाभिपर्यावर्तन्त॥
verses.tr: taṃ śraddhā ca yajñaśca lokaścānnaṃ cānnādyaṃ ca bhūtvābhiparyāvartanta
verses.en: Faith and Sacrifice and the world, having become food and nourishment, turned toward him.

verses.sa: ऐनं श्रद्धा गच्छत्यैनं यज्ञो गच्छत्यैनं लोको गच्छत्यैनमन्नं गच्छत्यैनमन्नाद्यं गच्छति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: ainaṃ śraddhā gacchatyainaṃ yajño gacchatyainaṃ loko gacchatyainamannaṃ gacchatyainamannādyaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: Faith, Sacrifice, the world, food and nourishment approach him who possesses this knowledge.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 8

verses.sa: सोऽरज्यत ततो राजन्योऽजायत॥
verses.tr: so'rajyata tato rājanyo'jāyata
verses.en: He was filled with passion: from him sprang the Rajanya,

verses.sa: स विशः सबन्धूनन्नमन्नाद्यमभ्युदतिष्ठत्॥
verses.tr: sa viśaḥ sabandhūnannamannādyamabhyudatiṣṭhat
verses.en: He came to the people, to kinsmen, food and nourishment.

verses.sa: विशां च वै स सबन्धूनां चान्नस्य चान्नाद्यस्य च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: viśāṃ ca vai sa sabandhūnāṃ cānnasya cānnādyasya ca priyaṃ dhāma bhavati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: He who possesses this knowledge becomes the dear home of the people, kinsmen, food and nourishment,

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 9

verses.sa: स विशोऽनु व्यऽचलत्॥
verses.tr: sa viśo'nu vya'calat
verses.en: He went away to the people.

verses.sa: तं सभा च समितिश्च सेना च शुरा चानुव्यऽचलन्॥
verses.tr: taṃ sabhā ca samitiśca senā ca śurā cānuvya'calan
verses.en: Meeting and Assembly and Army and Wine followed him,

verses.sa: सभायाश्च वै स समितेश्च सेनायाश्च सुरायाश्च प्रियं धाम भवति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: sabhāyāśca vai sa samiteśca senāyāśca surāyāśca priyaṃ dhāma bhavati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: He who hath this knowledge becomes the dear home of Meeting, Assembly, Army, and Wine.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 10

verses.sa: तद् यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्यो राज्ञोऽतिथिर्गृहानागच्छेत्॥
verses.tr: tad yasyaivaṃ vidvān vrātyo rājño'tithirgṛhānāgacchet
verses.en: So let the King, to whose house the Vratya who "possesses this knowledge comes as a guest,

verses.sa: श्रेयांसमेनमात्मनो मानयेत् तथा क्षत्राय ना वृश्चते तथा राष्ट्राय ना वृश्चते॥
verses.tr: śreyāṃsamenamātmano mānayet tathā kṣatrāya nā vṛścate tathā rāṣṭrāya nā vṛścate
verses.en: Honour him as superior to himself, So he doth not act against the interests of his princely rank or his kingdom,

verses.sa: अतो वै ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चोदतिष्ठतां ते अब्रूतां कं प्र विशावेति॥
verses.tr: ato vai brahma ca kṣatraṃ codatiṣṭhatāṃ te abrūtāṃ kaṃ pra viśāveti
verses.en: From him, verily, sprang Priesthood and Royalty. They said, Into whom shall we enter?

verses.sa: अतो वै बृहस्पतिमेव ब्रह्म प्रा विशत्विन्द्रं क्षत्रं तथा वा इति॥
verses.tr: ato vai bṛhaspatimeva brahma prā viśatvindraṃ kṣatraṃ tathā vā iti
verses.en: Let Priesthood enter into Brihaspati, and Royalty into Indra, was the answer,

verses.sa: अतो वै बृहस्पतिमेव ब्रह्म प्राविशदिन्द्रं क्षत्रम्॥
verses.tr: ato vai bṛhaspatimeva brahma prāviśadindraṃ kṣatram
verses.en: Hence Priesthood entered into Brihaspati and Royalty into Indra.

verses.sa: इयं वा उ पृथिवी बृहस्पतिर्द्यौरेवेन्द्रः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vā u pṛthivī bṛhaspatirdyaurevendraḥ
verses.en: Now this Earth is Brihaspati, and Heaven is Indra.

verses.sa: अयं वा उ अग्निर्ब्रह्मासावादित्यः क्षत्रम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vā u agnirbrahmāsāvādityaḥ kṣatram
verses.en: Now this Agni is Priesthood, and yonder Sun is Royalty.

verses.sa: ऐनं ब्रह्म गच्छति ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति॥
verses.tr: ainaṃ brahma gacchati brahmavarcasī bhavati
verses.en: Priesthood comes to him, and he becomes endowed with priestly lustre,

verses.sa: यः पृथिवीं बृहस्पतिमग्निं ब्रह्म वेद॥
verses.tr: yaḥ pṛthivīṃ bṛhaspatimagniṃ brahma veda
verses.en: Who knows that Earth is Brihaspati and Agni Priesthood,

verses.sa: ऐनमिन्द्रियं गच्छतीन्द्रियवान् भवति॥
verses.tr: ainamindriyaṃ gacchatīndriyavān bhavati
verses.en: Great power comes to him and he becomes endowed with great power,

verses.sa: य आदित्यं क्षत्रं दिवमिन्द्रं वेद॥
verses.tr: ya ādityaṃ kṣatraṃ divamindraṃ veda
verses.en: Who knows that Aditya is Royalty and that Heaven is Indra.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 11

verses.sa: तद् यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्योऽतिथिर्गृहानागछेत्॥
verses.tr: tad yasyaivaṃ vidvān vrātyo'tithirgṛhānāgachet
verses.en: Let him to whose house the Vratya who possesses this knowledge comes as a guest,

verses.sa:
स्वयमेनमभ्युदेत्य ब्रूयाद् व्रात्य क्वाऽवात्सीर्व्रात्योदकं व्रात्य तर्पयन्तु व्रात्य यथा ते प्रियं तथास्तु
व्रात्य यथा ते वशस्तथास्तु व्रात्य यथा ते निकामस्तथास्त्विति॥
verses.tr: svayamenamabhyudetya brūyād vrātya kvā'vātsīrvrātyodakaṃ vrātya tarpayantu vrātya yathā te priyaṃ tathāstu vrātya yathā te vaśastathāstu vrātya yathā te nikāmastathāstviti
verses.en: Rise up of his own accord to meet him, and say, Vratya, where didst thou pass the night? Vratya, here is water. Let them refresh thee, "Vratya, let it be as thou pleasest, Vratya, as thy wish is so let it be, Vratya, as thy desire is so be it.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य क्वाऽवात्सीरिति पथ एव तेन देवयानानव रुन्द्धे॥
verses.tr: yadenamāha vrātya kvā'vātsīriti patha eva tena devayānānava runddhe
verses.en: When he says to his guest, Where didst thou pass the night? he reserves for himself thereby the paths that lead to the Gods.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्योदकमित्यप एव तेनाव रुन्द्धे॥
verses.tr: yadenamāha vrātyodakamityapa eva tenāva runddhe
verses.en: When he says to him, Here is water, he secures thereby water for himself,

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य तर्पयन्त्विति प्राणमेव तेन वर्षीयांसं कुरुते॥
verses.tr: yadenamāha vrātya tarpayantviti prāṇameva tena varṣīyāṃsaṃ kurute
verses.en: When he says to him, Let them refresh thee, he thereby wins vital breath to exceeding old age.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य यथा ते प्रियं तथास्त्विति प्रियमेव तेनाव रुन्द्धे॥
verses.tr: yadenamāha vrātya yathā te priyaṃ tathāstviti priyameva tenāva runddhe
verses.en: When he says to him, Vratya, let it be as thou pleasest, he secures to himself thereby what is pleasant.

verses.sa: ऐनं प्रियं गच्छति प्रियः प्रियस्य भवति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: ainaṃ priyaṃ gacchati priyaḥ priyasya bhavati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: That which is pleasant comes to him, and he is the beloved of the beloved, who is possessed of this knowledge.

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य यथा ते वशस्तथास्त्विति वशमेव तेनाव रुन्द्धे॥
verses.tr: yadenamāha vrātya yathā te vaśastathāstviti vaśameva tenāva runddhe
verses.en: When he says to him, Vratya, as thy will is so let it be, he secures to himself thereby the fulfilment of his will.

verses.sa: ऐनं वशो गच्छति वशी वशिनां भवति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: ainaṃ vaśo gacchati vaśī vaśināṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: Authority comes to him who possesses this knowledge, and he becomes the controller of the powerful,

verses.sa: यदेनमाह व्रात्य यथा ते निकामस्तथास्त्विति निकाममेव तेनाव रुन्द्धे॥
verses.tr: yadenamāha vrātya yathā te nikāmastathāstviti nikāmameva tenāva runddhe
verses.en: When he says to him, Vratya, as thy desire is so be it, he secures to himself thereby the attainment of his desire.

verses.sa: ऐनं निकामो गच्छति निकामे निकामस्य भवति य एवं वेद॥
verses.tr: ainaṃ nikāmo gacchati nikāme nikāmasya bhavati ya evaṃ veda
verses.en: His desire comes to him who possesses this knowledge and he gains the complete satisfaction of his wish.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 12

verses.sa: तद् यस्यैवं विद्वान् व्रात्य उद्धृतेष्वग्निष्वधिश्रितेऽग्निहोत्रेऽतिथिर्गृहानागच्छेत्॥
verses.tr: tad yasyaivaṃ vidvān vrātya uddhṛteṣvagniṣvadhiśrite'gnihotre'tithirgṛhānāgacchet
verses.en: The man, to whose house, when the fires have been taken up from the hearth and the oblation to Agni placed therein, the Vratya possessing this knowledge comes as a guest,

verses.sa: स्वयमेनमभ्युदेत्य ब्रूयाद् व्रात्याति सृज होष्यामीति॥
verses.tr: svayamenamabhyudetya brūyād vrātyāti sṛja hoṣyāmīti
verses.en: Should of his own accord rise to meet him and say, Vratya, give me permission, a will sacrifice.

verses.sa: स चातिसृजेज्जुहुयान्न चातिसृजेन्न जुहुयात्॥
verses.tr: sa cātisṛjejjuhuyānna cātisṛjenna juhuyāt
verses.en: And if he gives permission he should sacrifice, if he does not permit him he should not sacrifice,

verses.sa:
स य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनातिसृष्टो जुहोति॥
प्र पितृयाणं पन्थां जानाति प्र देवयानम्॥
verses.tr: sa ya evaṃ viduṣā vrātyenātisṛṣṭo juhoti pra pitṛyāṇaṃ panthāṃ jānāti pra devayānam
verses.en: He who sacrifices when permitted by the Vratya who possesses this knowledge Well knows the path that leads to the Fathers and the way that leads to the Gods.

verses.sa: न देवेष्वा वृश्चते हुतमस्य भवति॥
verses.tr: na deveṣvā vṛścate hutamasya bhavati
verses.en: He does not act in opposition to the Gods, It becomes his sacrifice,

verses.sa: पर्यस्यास्मिंल्लोक आयतनं शिष्यते य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनातिसृष्टो जुहोति॥
verses.tr: paryasyāsmiṃlloka āyatanaṃ śiṣyate ya evaṃ viduṣā vrātyenātisṛṣṭo juhoti
verses.en: The abode of the man who sacrifices when permitted by the Vratya who possesses this knowledge is long left remaining in this world,

verses.sa:
अथ य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनानतिसृष्टो जुहोति॥
न पितृयाणं पन्थां जानाति न देवयानम्॥
verses.tr: atha ya evaṃ viduṣā vrātyenānatisṛṣṭo juhoti na pitṛyāṇaṃ panthāṃ jānāti na devayānam
verses.en: But he who sacrifices without the permission of the Vratya who possesses this knowledge Knows not the path that leads to the Fathers nor the way that leads to the Gods,

verses.sa: आ देवेषु वृश्चते अहुतमस्य भवति॥
verses.tr: ā deveṣu vṛścate ahutamasya bhavati
verses.en: He is at variance with the Gods. He hath offered no accepted sacrifice,

verses.sa: नास्यास्मिंल्लोक आयतनं शिष्यते य एवं विदुषा व्रात्येनानतिसृष्टो जुहोति॥
verses.tr: nāsyāsmiṃlloka āyatanaṃ śiṣyate ya evaṃ viduṣā vrātyenānatisṛṣṭo juhoti
verses.en: The abode of the man who sacrifices without the permission of the Vratya who possesses this knowledge is not left remaining in this world,

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 13

verses.en: He in whose house the Vratya who possesses this knowledge abides one night secures for himself thereby the holy realms that are on earth.
A second night, the holy realms that are in the firmament (the rest as in verse 1)
A third night. the holy realms that are in heaven.
A fourth night. the holy realms of the Holy.
Unlimited nights. unlimited holy realms.
Now he to whose house a non-Vratya, calling himself a Vratya, and one in name only, comes as a guest?
Should punish him and not punish him.
He should serve him with food, saying to himself, To this Deity I offer water; I lodge this Deity; I wait upon this, this Deity.
To that Deity the sacrifice of him who has this knowledge is acceptable,

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 14

verses.en: He, when he went away to the eastern region, went away having become the Marut host, and having made Mind an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with Mind as food-eater,
He, when he went away to the southern region, went away having become Indra, and having made Strength an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with strength as food-eater.
He, when he went away to the western region, went away having become King Varuna, and having made the Waters eaters of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with the Waters as food-eaters.

He, when he went away to the northern region, went away having become King Soma and having made the Seven Rishis oblation an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with oblation as food-eater,
He, when he went away to the stedfast region, went away having become Vishnu and having made Viraj an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with Viraj as food-eater.
He, when he went away to animals, went away having become Rudra and having made herbs eaters of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with herbs as food-eaters,

He, when he went away to the Fathers, went away having become King Yama and having made the exclamation Svadha an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with the exclamation Svadha as food-eater.
He, when he went away to men, went away having become Agni and having made the exclamation Svaha an eater of food, He who hath this knowledge eats food with the exclamation Svaha as food-eater.

He, when he went away to the upper region, went away having become Brihaspati and having made the exclamation Vashat an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with the exclamation Vashat as food-eater.
He, when he went away to the Gods, went away having become Isana and having made Passion an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with Passion as food-eater.
He, when he went away to creatures, went away having become Prajapati and having made vital breath an eater of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with vital breath as food-eater.
He, when he went away to all the intermediate spaces, went away having become Parameshthin and having made Devotion an eatar of food. He who hath this knowledge eats food with Devotion as food-eater.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 15

verses.sa:
तस्य व्रात्यस्य॥
सप्त प्राणाः सप्तापानाः सप्त व्यानाः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya sapta prāṇāḥ saptāpānāḥ sapta vyānāḥ
verses.en: Of that Vratya There are seven vital airs, seven downward breaths, seven diffused breaths.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य प्रथमः प्राण ऊर्ध्वो नामायं सो अग्निः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya prathamaḥ prāṇa ūrdhvo nāmāyaṃ so agniḥ
verses.en: His first vital breath, called Upward, is this Agni.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य द्वितीयः प्राणः प्रौढो नामासौ स आदित्यः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya dvitīyaḥ prāṇaḥ prauḍho nāmāsau sa ādityaḥ
verses.en: His second vital breath, called Mature, is that Aditya,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य तृतीयः प्राणो३ऽभ्यूऽढो नामासौ स चन्द्रमाः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya tṛtīyaḥ prāṇo3'bhyū'ḍho nāmāsau sa candramāḥ
verses.en: His third vital breath, called Approached, is that Moon,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य चतुर्थः प्राणो विभूर्नामायं स पवमानः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya caturthaḥ prāṇo vibhūrnāmāyaṃ sa pavamānaḥ
verses.en: His fourth vital breath, called Pervading, is this Pavamana,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य पञ्चमः प्राणो योनिर्नाम ता इमा आपः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya pañcamaḥ prāṇo yonirnāma tā imā āpaḥ
verses.en: His fifth vital breath. called Source, are these Waters,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य षष्ठः प्राणः प्रियो नाम त इमे पशवः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya ṣaṣṭhaḥ prāṇaḥ priyo nāma ta ime paśavaḥ
verses.en: His sixth vital breath, called Dear, are these domestic animals,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य सप्तमः प्राणोऽपरिमितो नाम ता इमाः प्रजाः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya saptamaḥ prāṇo'parimito nāma tā imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.en: His seventh vital breath, called Unlimited, are these creatures,

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 16

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य प्रथमोऽपानः सा पौर्णमासी॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya prathamo'pānaḥ sā paurṇamāsī
verses.en: His first downward breath is the time of Full Moon.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य द्वितीयोऽपानः साष्टका॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya dvitīyo'pānaḥ sāṣṭakā
verses.en: His second downward breath is the eighth day after Full Moon.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य तृतीयोऽपानः सामावास्या॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya tṛtīyo'pānaḥ sāmāvāsyā
verses.en: His third downward breath is the night of New Moon.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य चतुर्थोऽपानः सा श्रद्धा॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya caturtho'pānaḥ sā śraddhā
verses.en: His fourth downward breath is Faith.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य पञ्चमोऽपानः सा दीक्षा॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya pañcamo'pānaḥ sā dīkṣā
verses.en: His fifth downward breath is Consecration.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य षष्ठोऽपानः स यज्ञः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya ṣaṣṭho'pānaḥ sa yajñaḥ
verses.en: His sixth downward breath is Sacrifice,"

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य सप्तमोऽपानस्ता इमा दक्षिणाः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya saptamo'pānastā imā dakṣiṇāḥ
verses.en: His seventh downward breath are these sacrificial fees.

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 17

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य प्रथमो व्यानः सेयं भूमिः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya prathamo vyānaḥ seyaṃ bhūmiḥ
verses.en: His first diffused breath is this Earth.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य द्वितीयो व्यानस्तदन्तरिक्षम्॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya dvitīyo vyānastadantarikṣam
verses.en: His second oxen, diffused breath is that Firmament,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य तृतीयो व्यानः सा द्यौः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya tṛtīyo vyānaḥ sā dyauḥ
verses.en: His third diffused breath is that Heaven,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य ।योऽस्य चतुर्थो व्यानस्तानि नक्षत्राणि॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya caturtho vyānastāni nakṣatrāṇi
verses.en: His fourth diffused breath are those Constellations.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य पञ्चमो व्यानस्त ऋतवः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya pañcamo vyānasta ṛtavaḥ
verses.en: His fifth diffused breath are the Seasons.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य षष्ठो व्यानस्त आर्तवाः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya ṣaṣṭho vyānasta ārtavāḥ
verses.en: His sixth diffused breath are the Season-groups.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । योऽस्य सप्तमो व्यानः स संवत्सरः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yo'sya saptamo vyānaḥ sa saṃvatsaraḥ
verses.en: His seventh diffused breath is the year.

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । समानमर्थं परि यन्ति देवाः संवत्सरं वा एतदृतवोऽनुपरियन्ति व्रात्यं च॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya samānamarthaṃ pari yanti devāḥ saṃvatsaraṃ vā etadṛtavo'nupariyanti vrātyaṃ ca
verses.en: With one and the same object the Gods go round the Year and the Seasons follow round the Vratya,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । यदादित्यमभिसंविशन्त्यमावास्यां चैव तत् पौर्णमासीं च॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yadādityamabhisaṃviśantyamāvāsyāṃ caiva tat paurṇamāsīṃ ca
verses.en: When they surround the Sun on the day of New Moon, and that time of Full Moon,

verses.sa: तस्य व्रात्यस्य । एकं तदेषाममृतत्वमित्याहुतिरेव॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya ekaṃ tadeṣāmamṛtatvamityāhutireva
verses.en: That one immortality of theirs is just an oblation,

sections.label: The glorification of the Vratya, continued
sections.name: Book 15, hymn 18

verses.sa:
तस्य व्रात्यस्य॥
यदस्य दक्षिणमक्ष्यसौ स आदित्यो यदस्य सव्यमक्ष्यसौ स चन्द्रमाः॥
verses.tr: tasya vrātyasya yadasya dakṣiṇamakṣyasau sa ādityo yadasya savyamakṣyasau sa candramāḥ
verses.en: Of that Vratya The right eye is the Sun and the left eye is the Moon.

verses.sa: योऽस्य दक्षिणः कर्णोऽयं सो अग्निर्योऽस्य सव्यः कर्णोऽयं स पवमानः॥
verses.tr: yo'sya dakṣiṇaḥ karṇo'yaṃ so agniryo'sya savyaḥ karṇo'yaṃ sa pavamānaḥ
verses.en: His right ear is Agni and his left ear is Pavamana.

verses.sa: अहोरात्रे नासिके दितिश्चादितिश्च शीर्षकपाले संवत्सरः शिरः॥
verses.tr: ahorātre nāsike ditiścāditiśca śīrṣakapāle saṃvatsaraḥ śiraḥ
verses.en: Day and Night are his nostrils, Diti and Aditi are his head and skull.

verses.sa: अह्ना प्रत्यङ् व्रात्यो रात्र्या प्राङ् नमो व्रात्याय॥
verses.tr: ahnā pratyaṅ vrātyo rātryā prāṅ namo vrātyāya
verses.en: By day the Vratya is turned westward, by night he is turned eastward, Worship to the Vratya!
